messages:
maya: Heads-up — we're hitting the eu-west standby H100 queue for the new LLM sweep. Anyone have ETA on additional slots? cc @vendor-sales @oncall-bot
raj: We're still waiting on vendor PO approval, finance looped in. Vendor gave a tentative ship window, but no firm allocations yet.
sam: Who's covering billing for a short demo borrow? need a cost center to open PR.
maya: Can we borrow a small demo slice for canary? Need ~2 x H100 for ~6 hours tonight if possible.
vendor-sales: Hi @maya @raj — we can provide 2x H100 demo for up to 8h once contract #RWD-472 is signed. ETA ~6 business days for scheduled provision; otherwise next-available slot looks like 2026-11-10.
taylor: I can open a terraform PR to tag the pool for demo. @sam please confirm cost center so I can add it to the PR body.
maya: Quick terraform snippet for the pool tag: ```
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "canary" {
  region = "eu-west1"
  sku = "h100"
  count = 2
  ttl = "6h"
  tags = ["canary-sweep"]
}
```
taylor: thx — linking PR shortly: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/2145
oncall-bot: Ticket INF-1029 created for demo borrow request by maya. Assigned to raj.
vendor-sales: Quick Q — who is the legal contact to sign #RWD-472? Need name and email to expedite.
sam: I'll own payment once PR lands. Legal contact is Sam Huang <sam.h@redwood.ai>. Cost center: ENG-ML-07.
raj: assigning to procurement, scrambling internal approval. ping @taylor to prioritize PR review so finance can attach the cost center.
taylor: on it, aiming for review in the next 2 hours.
maya: awesome — if we get signoff we can run canary tonight PST. :thumbsup: 
vendor-sales: Noted. We'll standby and provision after legal confirms. Please update INF-1029 with the signed contract PDF when ready.
maya: will do, thanks everyone.
